question: What is a UAN and how do I activate it?
answer: UAN (Universal Account Number) is a 12-digit number given to every EPF member. It stays the same even if you change jobs. Activate it on the EPFO Member Portal (unifiedportal-mem.epfindia.gov.in) using your UAN, Aadhaar-linked mobile number and the OTP you receive.

question: How much is deducted for PF and what does the employer pay?
answer: The employee contributes 12% of basic pay plus dearness allowance. The employer also contributes 12%, of which 8.33% goes to the Employees' Pension Scheme (on wages up to the statutory ceiling) and the rest goes to the EPF account.

question: How do I check my PF balance or passbook?
answer: Log in at passbook.epfindia.gov.in with your UAN and password, or use the UMANG app. Your passbook shows employer and employee contributions month by month.

question: Where can I file a complaint with EPFO?
answer: You can register a grievance on the EPFiGMS portal (epfigms.gov.in). You receive a registration number to track the status.

question: Why do I need to link Aadhaar and bank details to my UAN?
answer: Aadhaar, PAN and bank details linked (KYC-verified) to your UAN are generally needed for online claims and for the money to be paid to the right bank account. You can update KYC in the Member Portal under Manage > KYC.

question: How do I transfer my PF when I change jobs?
answer: Make sure your new employer has linked your existing UAN, then file an online transfer claim from the Member Portal (Online Services > One Member - One EPF Account). The claim is attested by the employer.
